name: Thunderale restores 6% of health and mana per second for 25 sec (#10807)
contract: Thunderale (item 2000150, handed out by Conjure Thunderkeg through Conjure Thunderale 807850) reads "Restores
6% of your health and mana per second for 25 sec. Must remain seated while drinking.". Its use spell 804762
carried flat regeneration auras (84 and 85, 17 health and 42 mana per tick for 18 sec), far too little at the
level cap. The core turns 804762 into the percentage drink every Food spell is: effect 0 SPELL_AURA_OBS_MOD_HEALTH
and effect 1 SPELL_AURA_OBS_MOD_POWER on mana, both 6 with 1 sec ticks, 25 sec long. A level 60 Stormbringer
drinks it while nearly empty and must gain well over the 12% two ticks give within 3.5 seconds, in both pools.

steps.label: At least two ticks of 6% of maximum health landed
Mana is restored as a fraction of its maximum: at least two 6% ticks in 3.5 seconds
